title: Selected Works — Vol. 1
author: Mao Zedong
desc: Primeros escritos: análisis de clases en China, movimiento campesino de Hunan, guerra de guerrillas.
tesis: Los primeros escritos de Mao (1926-1937) contienen sus textos más originales: el Informe sobre el Movimiento Campesino de Hunan (donde descubre la fuerza revolucionaria del campesinado), el Análisis de las Clases en la Sociedad China (donde identifica aliados y enemigos de la revolución), y los primeros textos sobre guerra de guerrillas. Es el Mao que inventó el marxismo campesino contra la ortodoxia que decía que solo el proletariado industrial podía hacer la revolución.
ideas: El campesinado es la fuerza principal de la revolución en países coloniales y semicoloniales — contra la ortodoxia que privilegiaba al proletariado urbano.
El análisis de clases es la primera tarea de todo revolucionario: saber quiénes son amigos y quiénes enemigos.
La guerra de guerrillas es la forma de lucha de los pueblos débiles contra enemigos poderosos.
contexto: Publicado en 1951 por Ediciones en Lenguas Extranjeras de Pekín; los textos datan de 1926-1937. Incluye el Informe sobre el Movimiento Campesino de Hunan (1927) y los primeros textos sobre guerra de guerrillas escritos durante la Gran Marcha.

conexiones.razon: Lenin definió el partido de vanguardia urbano; Mao creó la revolución campesina — dos caminos al socialismo.
Ho Chi Minh y Mao hicieron revoluciones campesinas anticoloniales — el maoísmo influyó directamente en Vietnam.

quotes.text: Who are our enemies? Who are our friends? This is a question of the first importance for the revolution.

tl: Análisis de las clases en la sociedad china

Who are our enemies? Who are our friends? This is a question of the first importance for the revolution. The basic reason why all previous revolutionary struggles in China achieved so little was their failure to unite with real friends.
Derrota de la Gran Revolución y guerra de guerrillas

Our war began in the autumn of 1927, and we then had no experience at all. The Nanchang Uprising and the Canton Uprising failed, and in the Autumn Harvest Uprising the Red Army in the Hunan-Hupeh-Kiangsi border area also suffered several defeats.
Investigación campesina en Hunan

During my recent visit to Hunan I made a first-hand investigation of conditions in the five counties of Hsiangtan, Hsianghsiang, Hengshan, Liling and Changsha. In the thirty-two days from January 4 to February 5.
Asociaciones campesinas toman el poder rural

The membership of the associations jumped to two million and the masses directly under their leadership increased to ten million. The peasants went into action and within four months brought about a great revolution.
La revolución no es una cena de gala

A revolution is not a dinner party, or writing an essay, or painting a picture, or doing embroidery; it cannot be so refined, so leisurely and gentle, so temperate, kind, courteous, restrained and magnanimous.
Fórmula de dieciséis caracteres en Chingkang

By May 1928 however, basic principles of guerrilla warfare, simple in nature and suited to the conditions of the time, had already been evolved, that is, the sixteen-character formula: The enemy advances, we retreat; the enemy camps, we harass.
Por qué puede existir el poder rojo en China
The long-term survival inside a country of one or more small areas under Red political power completely encircled by a White regime is a phenomenon that has never occurred anywhere else in the world.
Por qué puede existir el poder rojo en China

China is the only country in the world today where one or more small areas under Red political power have emerged in the midst of encirclement by a White regime. One reason lies in the incessant splits and wars.
Una chispa puede incendiar la pradera

The policy adopted by Chu Teh and Mao Tse-tung and also by Fang Chih-min is undoubtedly correct, that is, the policy of establishing base areas; of systematically setting up political power; of deepening the agrarian revolution.
Atender el trabajo económico en Kiangsi

Only by extending the work on the economic front and building the economy of the Red areas can we provide an adequate material basis for the revolutionary war, proceed smoothly with our military offensives and strike effective blows.
Política económica en la República Soviética de Juichin

This report was given by Comrade Mao Tse-tung at the Second National Congress of Workers' and Peasants' Representatives held in Juichin, Kiangsi Province in January 1934. The 1933 agricultural output was 15 per cent higher in southern Kiangsi.
Inicio de la Larga Marcha

The Sixth Army Group led by Jen Pi-shih began to shift to Comrade Ho Lung's area in August last year, and in October we ourselves started to shift position. In March this year the Red Army in the Szechuan-Shensi border area began its shift.
Conferencia de Tsunyi

In January 1935, at an enlarged meeting of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee which was convened in Tsunyi, Kweichow Province, a new Central Committee leadership headed by Comrade Mao Tse-tung had been established.
La Larga Marcha como máquina sembradora

The Long March is also a seeding-machine. In the eleven provinces it has sown many seeds which will sprout, leaf, blossom, and bear fruit, and will yield a harvest in the future. The Long March has ended with victory for us and defeat for the enemy.
Victoria de Chihlochen en Shensi

In the battle of Chihlochen the Central Red Army and the Northwestern Red Army, fighting in fraternal solidarity, shattered the traitor Chiang Kai-shek's campaign of encirclement and suppression against the Shensi-Kansu border area.
Tácticas contra el imperialismo japonés en Wayaopao

This report was given by Comrade Mao Tse-tung at the conference of Party activists which was held at Wayaopao, northern Shensi, after the Wayaopao meeting of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee in December 1935.
"Sobre la practica": conocer haciendo

Marxists hold that man's social practice alone is the criterion of the truth of his knowledge of the external world. This is what is meant by failure is the mother of success and a fall into the pit, a gain in your wit.
Frente unido antijaponés en Yenan

Our united front should include the bourgeoisie and all who agree to the defence of the motherland, it should represent national solidarity against the foreign foe. This task not only must, but can, be fulfilled.
